subject: Post-discovery: subprocessor & compliance triage for NovaPay
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Luis Maldonado <luis.maldonado@novapay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: subprocessor & compliance triage for NovaPay

Hi Luis,

Thanks again for taking the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment after the demo/discovery: 

Recap (what we heard)
- NovaPay is evaluating Redwood for transaction orchestration + tokenized storage; primary concerns were PCI scope reduction, SOC 2 evidence, and EU data residency for a subset of customers.
- You currently tokenize card data via a vaulting provider and use AWS for most production workloads; Azure is used in a EU region for back-office processing.
- SOC 2 Type II is in progress with an expected attestation window in Q4 (you mentioned "targeting November to December").

Immediate asks from our side
1) Please share your current subprocessor list (cloud providers, monitoring, analytics, tokenization/Vaulting provider). A CSV or spreadsheet is perfect.
2) If available, send the most recent SOC 2 report or a bridge letter and the expected attestation date.
3) Confirm any PCI-related scope boundaries (which systems hold PAN vs tokens, any processors that touch cleartext).
4) Start the vendor security questionnaire — attached is our short questionnaire (we'll also import this into HubSpot security workflow).

Attachments: redwood-subprocessors-20261105.csv (stub), redwood-security-questionnaire-short.pdf (linkable stub)

Proposed next steps / owners
- Luis: send subprocessor CSV and SOC2/PCI notes (by EOD Tue, 11/10 if possible).
- Karthik (cc): we will open a security intake and send the questionnaire via secure link; Karthik will follow up to schedule a 30-min wrap call.
- Marissa: I'll loop in Solutions (if needed) for a deeper infra walkthrough after we see the data flow.

If anything above is off, flag it and I'll correct. Otherwise we'll treat this as our action plan and sync next week.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference (demo recording linked in HubSpot)

From: Luis Maldonado <luis.maldonado@novapay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novapay.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: subprocessor & compliance triage for NovaPay

Monica,

Appreciate the clear recap — yes, that's accurate. Quick answers and what I'll attach: 

What I can share now
- Subprocessors: AWS (us-east-1), Microsoft Azure (eu-west-2), FastVault Inc. (tokenization service), Loglytics (monitoring), SmtpRelay (email deliverability). I'll attach a CSV with the contacts.
- SOC 2: our SOC 2 Type II is underway; control testing completed in late Oct. Expected formal report delivery: mid-December. We can provide a bridge letter and the auditor contact (KPMG) sooner.
- PCI: card PANs are never stored in our systems; tokens are stored in FastVault. Tokenization service is within scope for PCI; we are collecting evidence for our SAQ and hope to complete attestation this quarter.

Attachments: novapay-subprocessors-20261105.csv (stub), novapay-data-flow-v1.drawio (stub)

Questions for Redwood
- Do you have a standard minimum that Redwood requires for subprocessor contracts (for example, DPA + SOC2 or PCI attestation)?
- Are there particular encryption/KMS requirements for keys in transit/at rest when we integrate?

I'll upload the files to a secure share and reply with a link; aiming to get everything to you by Monday EOD (11/09).

Best,
Luis Maldonado
Head of Security Operations, NovaPay
luis.maldonado@novapay.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: subprocessor & compliance triage for NovaPay

Thanks, Monica / Luis — good notes. Internal next steps from the security intake perspective: 

1) I'll open a vendor-security ticket and attach Monaco's (NovaPay's) subprocessors and the draw.io flow — ticket will capture PCI boundary questions and expected SOC2 delivery date.
2) I'll send NovaPay our short questionnaire via the secure vendor portal; the questionnaire includes specific PCI scoping questions (does any Redwood component receive PAN, tokenization endpoints, etc.).
3) Requesting Marissa to kick off the subprocessor mapping worksheet update once we get the CSV so we can map any overlapping providers (e.g., Loglytics) and surface any high-risk ones.

Items I need from NovaPay to triage properly:
- Full contact for FastVault (POC + SOC2/PCI evidence)
- Whether Azure EU workloads are subject to GDPR customer residency requirements currently in-scope for Redwood integration
- Any existing BAA (if HIPAA came up with any customers using NovaPay) — if not applicable, confirm.

I'll tentatively schedule a 30-min triage call for Tue 11/10 10:00am PT; Monica, can you confirm that works with the customer?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security Integrations, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Luis Maldonado <luis.maldonado@novapay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 18:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: subprocessor & compliance triage for NovaPay

Luis — perfect, thanks. Monday EOD (11/09) timeline works. I'll confirm the 11/10 10:00am PT triage call after we see your upload. 

To answer one of your questions up front: Redwood's baseline for subprocessors is a signed DPA + either a recent SOC 2 report or equivalent control evidence; for PCI tokenization services we also want to see the token provider's PA-DSS/PCI attestation or their PCI assessor contact. KMS: we require customer keys to be managed with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit; if you use an HSM provider, please list it in the subprocessor sheet.

I'll send a calendar invite once Luis confirms availability. Thanks all — will follow up with the HubSpot record and the secure questionnaire link.

Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
